description: Read a page of an order’s tickets for an event. Follow nextCursor even on an empty page and restart after changes. Tickets without an identifiable event cannot be included.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the preceding page.

eventId.description: Event ID. Defaults to the active event.

limit.description: Maximum tickets to return, from 1 to 100.

name: list_order_tickets_page

consistency.description: A live walk; restart after ticket changes to avoid missed or repeated tickets.

items.description: Visible tickets in this page, without nested add-ons.

orderItemId.description: Order item holding the ticket, when linked.

nextCursor.description: Pass this cursor to read another page; null means finished.

title: List order tickets page
